snippet.title: No Man's Sky The Swarm Trailer
snippet.description:
A new danger has appeared in the No Man's Sky universe. Something terrible hangs in the sky: a huge, foreboding Hive-like ship, unlike anything we've seen before. It has nigh-on impenetrable defences, not least a swarm of smaller and nimbler battle drones which must be neutralised to get close enough to target its primary weapon systems, notably the biggest laser cannon our universe has ever witnessed. 

It will take a combined community effort to take it down, but the Traveller soul is fragmented into three; all three groups are competing for glory, but will also need to co-operate and strategise to take down this existential threat to the universe.

Epic and chaotic space battles await for the bravest and nimblest space pilots who dare to take on this faceless but formidable technological terror which has mysteriously appeared. Fully decked out S-Class ships assemble!

Full patch notes here: https://www.nomanssky.com/swarm-update

snippet.title: Disclosure Day | Final Trailer
snippet.description:
Believe it when you see it. Get tickets now. Disclosure Day only in theaters June 12.
______
If you found out we weren’t alone, if someone showed you, proved it to you, would that frighten you? This summer, the truth belongs to eight billion people. 
We are coming close to … Disclosure Day. 

Universal Pictures is proud to release a new original event film created and directed by Steven Spielberg. The film stars SAG winner and Oscar® nominee Emily Blunt (Oppenheimer, A Quiet Place), Emmy and Golden Globe winner Josh O’Connor (Challengers, The Crown), Oscar® winner Colin Firth (The King’s Speech, Kingsman franchise), Eve Hewson (Bad Sisters, The Perfect Couple) and two-time Oscar® nominee Colman Domingo (Sing Sing, Rustin).
 
Based on a story by Spielberg, the screenplay is by David Koepp, whose previous work with Spielberg includes the scripts for Jurassic Park, The Lost World: Jurassic Park, War of the Worlds and Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull. Combined, those films earned more than $3 billion worldwide. Koepp also wrote the script for this 2025’s Jurassic World Rebirth. 

Disclosure Day is produced by five-time Academy Award® nominee Kristie Macosko Krieger (The Fabelmans, West Side Story) and by Spielberg for Amblin Entertainment. The executive producers are Adam Somner and Chris Brigham. 

Steven Spielberg is one of the industry’s most successful and influential filmmakers. The top-grossing director of all time, Spielberg has helmed such blockbusters as Jaws, E.T. The Extra-Terrestrial, the Indiana Jones franchise and Jurassic Park. 
 
Among his myriad honors, he is a three-time Academy Award® winner, including Oscars® for Best Director and Best Picture for Schindler’s List, which received a total of seven Oscars®, and for Best Director for Saving Private Ryan. His most recent film, The Fabelmans, was released by Universal in 2022 and received seven Academy Award® nominations, including for Directing, Best Original Screenplay, Best Actress and Best Picture.

sacrifice my life just to hold you

here in my arms

Bruno Mars is a 16x GRAMMY®-winning global superstar, singer, songwriter, multi-instrumentalist, producer, and one of the most-streamed artists in the world. Known for his showmanship and chart-toppers, Bruno has set a number of records throughout his career, including becoming the first artist ever to hit 150 million monthly listeners on Spotify, appearing on two of the fastest songs to reach one billion streams (for “Die with a Smile” with Lady Gaga and “APT.” with ROSÉ, and achieving the highest-certified song in RIAA history with 2010’s “Just the Way You Are”). Since launching a string of hits beginning in 2009, Bruno has sold over 150 million records worldwide, making him one of the best-selling artists of all time. Beyond his work as a soloist, Bruno is a member of the duo Silk Sonic with Anderson .Paak. In addition to his 35 Billboard Hot 100 hits, including nine number one singles, Bruno is the recipient of 16 GRAMMY® Awards (including “Album of the Year” for 24K Magic), 14 American Music Awards, and seven MTV Video Music Awards. His 24K Magic World Tour was among the highest-grossing tours in history, and within the top ten highest-grossing of the 2010s.

#BrunoMars #RiskItAll #TheRomanticTour

What is Roblox? ROBLOX is an online virtual playground and workshop, where kids of all ages can safely interact, create, have fun, and learn. It’s unique in that practically everything on ROBLOX is designed and constructed by members of the community. ROBLOX is designed for 13 to 18 year olds, but it is open to people of all ages. Each player starts by choosing an avatar and giving it an identity. They can then explore ROBLOX — interacting with others by chatting, playing games, or collaborating on creative projects. Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation. There is no cost for this first plot of virtual land. By participating and by building cool stuff, ROBLOX members can earn specialty badges as well as ROBLOX dollars (“Robux”). In turn, they can shop the online catalog to purchase avatar clothing and accessories as well as premium building materials, interactive components, and working mechanisms.

snippet.title: Mina the Hollower Review
snippet.description:
Mina the Hollower reviewed by Samuel Claiborn on PC, also available on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2.

Mina The Hollower will burrow into your brain and set up a cozy little house there. And I couldn’t let it go: Clues to unsolved puzzles pop into my brain before bed; a spot high out of reach that I never set foot on beckons me every time I pass it; that secret boss that destroyed me could be beatable with one really good grinding spot. Mina achieves the same heights in both action and style that its impressive inspirations reach on a regular basis, be that Zelda, Castlevania, or FromSoft RPGs. Even if all you’ve played is Breath of the Wild and Elden Ring, don’t let the retro look fool you: Mina the Hollower will scratch the same itch, with an open world that’s crammed with mysteries worth exploring and lively, clever combat I couldn’t get enough of. It’s a big game in a small package, and an absolute masterpiece of an adventure.

#IGN #MinaTheHollower #Review

Marathon's Open Play Week is June 2 – June 9 on PlayStation 5, Steam, and XBOX Series X|S. 
Learn more: https://www.bungie.net/7/en/News/Article/welcome_season_2

snippet.title: F1 25: 2026 Season Pack Features Deep Dive
snippet.description:
Rewrite the Grid when the 2026 Season Pack for EA SPORTS™ F1® 25 launches worldwide on June 3, 2026. Wishlist now: https://x.ea.com/89231

Wishlist the F1® 25: 2026 Season Pack on Xbox Series X|S, Steam, and EA Play.

In this deep dive, you'll learn all about the groundbreaking new era of F1® and the 2026 rules and regulations. 

Get ready for action-packed racing as you tactically use the new Overtake mode and active aerodynamics to outsmart the grid and propel yourself to victory. 

Master the new MADRING circuit and forge your racing legacy to fight for Championship Glory in Career mode, or take control of your own team and become the 12th team on the grid in My Team, where you can customize your car and line up alongside new teams, Audi and Cadillac. 

Jump into the 2026 Season across Driver Career, My Team, Grand Prix™, Time Trial, Split-Screen, and Unranked Multiplayer modes. In Driver Career and My Team, start a new 2026 save to get the latest teams, drivers, rules, fresh Objectives, and an updated Calendar featuring the new Spanish Grand Prix™. In My Team, your custom squad will now be the twelfth on the grid, as the official grid expands to eleven teams in 2026.

snippet.title: Game Developer VS 𝔹ℝ𝕀𝕋𝕀𝕊ℍ - Tiny Terraces A PERFECTLY BALANCED GAME WITH NO EXPLOITS
snippet.description:
Welcome To Tiny Terraces a fantastic farming tycoon game made by a fantastically talented solo developer. It is a mix between stardew valley and an idle game with a simple core focus on building a tiny terrace and slowly automating the entire farming process like you would in a normal game of factorio. However The developer has made one terrible mistake they have wrongly used an American flag as the icon for the English language of the game. I simply cannot let this stand and so it is up to the spiffing brit (Evil British Youtuber and game breaker) to show you how to take a great indie game like tiny terraces and break its balance with the power of path finding bugs. 

Chapters:
00:00 - Intro
01:14 - Our Tiny Terrace
04:52 - Expanding our Work Force
08:00 - Unlocking more items
09:21 - Exploiting the Game
13:15 - Our first steps to Automation
15:31 - The Coffee Trials
18:21 - The Tea Redemption
19:55 - The Tea farm grows!
22:09 - Full scale production
22:53 - Becoming a millionaire
23:40 - Outro & Thanks for Watching!

This is not a sponsored video but if you liked the look of the game you can grab it probably in a steam summer sale here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3136330/Tiny_Terraces/

snippet.title: How to get the TOP 10 Must Have Cars ► Forza Horizon 6
snippet.description:
This is a video guide on how to get the top 10 must have cars on Forza Horizon 6. Ranging from the fastest, both on road or offroad, drifting or even stunt cars. Some of these are also the best for farming credits and car mastery skill points.

⏱️ Timestamps:
0:00 2018 Lotus Scura Motrosports Exige WTAC
- Insane control and turning speed handling, touge & offroad leaderboard
How to get: Road Racing Reward

2:32 1994 Mazda MX-5 Miata Forza Edition
- Fastest drag speed and launch
How to get: Aftermarket Car at Festival Kilometer Drag Meet

4:21 1999 Dodge Viper GTS ACR Forza Edition
- Insane speed and acceleration for offroad traction
How to get: VIP Membership DLC Pack

5:58 2020 Lotus Evija Forze Edition
- Best drifting car and used for high speed circuits like the Colossus
How to get: Wheelspins or Auction House

7:34 1985 Toyota Sprinter Trueno GT-APEX Forze Edition
- Highest top speed in straight line
How to get: Master Explorer at 5000 points

9:50 2019 Toyota Tacoma TRD Pro Forza Edition

10:38 OR 2020 Wuling Sunshine S Forza Edition
- Credits boosts for credit farming
How to get: VIP Membership DLC Pack / Wheelspins or Auction House

14:02 1991 Mazda #55 Mazda 787B
- Best Street Circuit racing car
How to get: Barnfind Endgame in Takashiro Region

16:14 2018 Ferrari FXX-K Evo 'Welcome Pack'
- High speed circuits with handling
How to get: Autoshow or Welcome Pack DLC

16:59 2018 Mercedes-Bens X-Class
- Cross country low class
How to get: Buy at Autoshow

18:00 1998 Subaru Imperza 2B-STi Version
- Car mastery skill point farming
How to get: Buy for 88000 at Autoshow

snippet.title: 007 First Light Review - The Final Verdict
snippet.description:
Well, we got to play 007 First Light, and we’ve come away very impressed. It’s always great when a game’s creative and technical sides blend well to present a cohesive experience. 

Throw in a solid Bond story with a fresh take on the iconic character, and you’ve got yourself a winner. IO Interactive clearly felt the same and delivered a game that has taken us on a wild ride through the world of espionage and spy craft that MI6 takes for granted. It’s been a blast for many reasons, and we’re delighted to tell you about all of them. Join us for a review of a game whose wait has been well worth the reward.

Welcome back to Just Create Season 2!

In this episode of Just Create, I dive into upgrading the Peak Transport gondola network! 

First, I tackle the broken Obsidimall swap shop and get a brand new water tank exchange up and running.

I design a custom turnstile system using Create Mod item hatches, smart observers, and pulse extenders to process single riders and season passes.
